Animate iTRAK5730 movers on the HMI 5.0 - Support for v5 iTRAK Device Handler, AOI name change, support for Linear iTRAK 5730 Instruction Overview: ----- The instruction updates pixels in a HMI to animate movers moving around an iTRAK. The AOI works for all the iTRAK 5730 and iTRAK 5750 configurations (oval, rectangle/square, linear). Based on the Cfg_LeftMotor_X, Cfg_LeftMotor Y position and track layout information (number of horizontal, vertical sections), all the other important pixel positions around the track are computed by the Add On Instruction which is then used to calculate the movers position and orientation values as they move around the track.
NOTE: While the mover pixel calculations are run every scan, the track pixel positions are done only during the rising edge transition. If any of the input parameters are changed (except Inp_CommandPosition) then the rung in condition has to transition from FALSE to TRUE which will recalculate the pixel positions of the track.
